ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Active'), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Expiring <30 days'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Expired') ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Expiring 30-90 days'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Expiring <30 days')) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Expiring <30 days'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Expired')) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Expired'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Finalized')) ) ) )
